description: Points the domain's www address and bare domain at the business's website on Upful. The bare domain forwards to www.
variableDescription: %target%: the CNAME target Upful's hosting assigns to its websites (e.g. 1a0c274fe87f15f6.vercel-dns-016.com); %ip%: the IPv4 address Upful's hosting answers the bare domain on (e.g. 216.150.1.1); %vercelverify%: the hosting's ownership token, sent only with the verify group when the hosting asks for proof
